column2: Write a 150-word abstract for our paper showing that deer herbivory pressure, measured as abundance times feeding time from camera traps, varies across the eastern US.
Draft a one-page specific aims for an NSF proposal on statistical methods for using AI species identifications in occupancy models.
Write a short blog post for a general audience about how fishers came back to Ohio.
Tighten this sentence from my manuscript: "We do not claim that a shift of that size carries a measurable cost to the animal, rather than merely a statistical one."
Write a three-sentence email to a co-author saying the revised methods section is attached and asking for comments by Friday.
I have a camera trap deployments table with deployment_id, start_time, end_time, latitude, longitude from three Snapshot USA projects. What should I check before fitting occupancy models?
I am starting a new R project to model coyote occupancy from our camera trap data. Set up how we should organize the code and track progress.
Picking up the diel activity analysis again after two weeks. The cluster says the last batch of model fits completed. What should we do next?
The new figure functions work. Save this code and get it up to GitHub.
I downloaded GBIF and Movebank records for North American carnivores and want to combine them with our Snapshot USA camera data into one species table.
Are coyotes more nocturnal at camera sites with higher human population density? We have detections from about 300 sites.
I have 300 museum specimen records with locality text like '5 mi NE of Boone, Watauga Co.' and need latitude, longitude and uncertainty for each.
We have 2 million new camera trap images to label. Help me set up MegaDetector and a Label Studio review queue.
Compare daily activity overlap between coyotes and deer at our sites; coyotes have 40 detections and deer 400.
Fit an integrated step-selection function on these caribou GPS collars in amt: generate random steps, annotate NDVI, fit with clogit, and tell me whether the movement parameters need updating.
